contractChanges.REL-001: Done: deploy keys and the owner record per-environment deployment start, progress with exposure, success, failure and rollback with build, repository, commit and ordered included commits; retried callbacks are idempotent, changed retries are refused, an overdue start is marked timed out and sends one notice; Releases shows the history. Caller-recorded commits claim no repository ancestry (SRC-002).
contractChanges.AUDIT-001: Done: every Spool write, denial, export, restore and notification commits one attributed privacy-safe fact (permanent actor and subject aliases, action, time, truthful outcome) in the same transaction; Settings pages and exports it as JSON or CSV; archives carry it and restore appends it; erasure removes alias links only.

agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.5.0: export a private archive first (Settings > Download private archive, or rer export --output exports/spool.rer with local dev stopped). In a checkout of main run git pull; in a checkout of an earlier tag run git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.5.1. Then rer dev locally, or rer deploy from the original deploying checkout for a hosted installation. Five additive migrations apply (0049_deployment_history through 0053_audit_transactions, 53 total); 0050 clears only derived release-ordering keys, which are recomputed. Existing projects, evidence, triage states, grouping rules, inbound filters, alert rules and project keys are preserved. Keep the existing database, local settings, project keys and deployment receipts; do not reset or restore into the populated installation. Earlier upgrades apply the migrations described in CHANGELOG.md. Archives made by 0.5.0 or earlier restore only into an empty installation. A hosted restore that is cut off no longer blocks the installation: retries answer import_running until its five-minute lease lapses, then the next restore completes; no remove and redeploy is needed. The application pins rer 0.2.69. SDK 0.2.0 remains unpublished on npm and is not published by this app release.
publicReleaseNotes: Spool 0.5.1 fixes 0.5.0's known issue: a hosted restore that is cut off mid-way no longer blocks the installation, and once its five-minute lease lapses the next restore completes without a redeploy. It adds deployment history: deploy keys and the owner record each environment's deployment start, progress, success, failure and rollback with its build and included commits, and an overdue start sends one notice. Every change Spool makes now records a privacy-safe audit fact of who did what, to what and with what outcome, which Settings pages and exports and archives carry. Scrubbing keeps UUIDs and trace ids whole. Upgrading from 0.5.0 applies five additive migrations and keeps existing data; back up first. The release gate upgraded a populated 0.5.0 install, restored a 0.5.0 archive carrying a platform migration ledger into a fresh one, ran a real browser app with the published SDK and the Sentry SDK side by side locally and on a fresh Cloudflare deployment, delivered a real new-issue alert email, restored a hosted backup after removing and redeploying, and recovered a cut-off hosted restore. Known issue: a retry right after a cut-off hosted restore is refused for up to five minutes. No Sentry feature parity, Bugsnag or Rollbar support is claimed, and this app release does not publish the SDK. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/spool-issue-page-1600.png
